dedupe_keys.name: multi stage lithium ion battery ageing analysis tools

description: The multi-stage battery-ageing research team publishes Python tools for loading and analysing its lithium-ion experiments. The repository documents data import, filtering and outlier correction, followed by extraction of capacity, direct-current internal resistance and open-circuit-voltage features. A Jupyter notebook demonstrates basic analyses, and a requirements file describes dependencies. Source access is public and free under MIT. Coverage follows the associated two-stage Samsung cell campaign, with functions reusable for matching input structures. Extracted features can support degradation simulations and battery-lifetime assumptions for model-pypsa studies. A caveat is that correction rules can change the degradation signal and should be retained alongside unmodified observations. Cell identifiers and stage-specific test conditions must remain linked during comparison. No package installation, feature extraction or model fitting was performed.
